pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu Kosalesu janapadesu Sāvatthiṃ gacchanto aññatarena gāmadvārena atikkamati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.3: aññatarā itthi sāmikena saha bhaṇḍitvā gāmato nikkhamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ passitvā etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.8: atha kho tassā itthiyā sāmiko gāmato nikkhamitvā manusse pucchi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.11: atha kho so puriso anubandhitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ gahetvā ākoṭetvā muñci.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.12: atha kho so bhikkhu aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle padhūpento nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.13: atha kho sā itthi taṃ purisaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.15: api ca aham eva tena bhikkhunā saddhiṃ gacchāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.18: atha kho so puriso taṃ bhikkhuṃ khamāpesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.19: atha kho so bhikkhu Sāvatthiṃ gantvā bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.21: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhu mātugāmena saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjissatīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.22: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ bhikkhu mātugāmena saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjasīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.25: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa mātugāmena . . . paṭipajjissasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.26: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.27: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.28.1: yo pana bhikkhu mātugāmena saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjeyya antamaso gāmantaraṃ pi, pācittiyan ti. ||1||

pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:2.2.1: mātugāme mātugāmasaññī saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjati antamaso gāmantaraṃ pi, āpatti pācittiyassa.
